name: Muradin's old lesson
summary: Muradin receives the dull training sword he once used with Arthas in Lordaeron. Its blunted edge bears none of the blood of later wars, yet its weight draws back days of teaching and regret. Muradin wonders how events might have changed had he stopped Arthas from discovering Frostmourne. A practice blade from an earlier life becomes the part of Arthas he mourns: a young man still being taught.
